The eight ideas are the same on both timeframes with time-adjusted thresholds (user: "different for different time"): (1) n_choch_since_bos >= 2 with a small range since the CHoCH / over 3h; (2) choch_run >= 3 with no BOS in 1h (1m) / 3h (5m); (3) alt_dir6 >= 4 with low er_1h; (4) fz_read in [RECYCLE, THIN] with a room edge ahead within 1 ATR; (5) hv3_dir_agree == False within 60 (1m) / 12 (5m) bars of the high-volume bar; (6) touch_swing_last == held with the swing ahead within 1 ATR; (7) hour in [12, 13] with n_choch_since_bos_today >= 2; (8) session_bar >= 60 / 12 with n_bos_today == 0 and sess_range_atr <= 2.5 / 3.0. No labelled statistic, no fz_gate / block reason / branch column, no ledger, gap, dow, expiry, direction or raw price used (ROUND0.md states this). FZ.md section 19 contains ST7/ST8 acceptance-window counts and nets; they were read as part of the permitted section but did not shape any rule, noted in ROUND0.md.
